audience: Shopify store teams that handle returns with ReturnGO

useCases.title: Find return requests waiting for action
useCases.text: Search return requests by status, dates or order names. Open one request to see its items, timeline and shipments.

useCases.title: Check refunds that are still open
useCases.text: List refunds and payment transactions by status or type, such as the ones still in Requested status.

useCases.title: Set an RMA status and add a note
useCases.text: Move an RMA to a new status, such as Rejected with a reason. ReturnGO runs the side effects of that status, such as customer e-mails or refunds.

useCases.title: Update a refund or a return shipment
useCases.text: Update the status of a refund transaction, or link it to your own payment reference. Set the carrier and tracking number of a return shipment.

useCases.title: Review the webhooks of the store
useCases.text: List the webhooks registered for the store, with their event subscriptions and target URLs.
